description: Rigid-lattice ensemble (SL assumed to exist; colloidal states excluded): positions fixed on the experimental 3x3x3 rhombohedral lattice (a = 21 nm, alpha = 74.2 deg); sampled at 298.15 K: every cube's body orientation, every moment, and the lattice orientation as a whole (co-tilt with the bodies). 500 G, converged vdW with the D0 core minimum. Steps from outputs/pilot_tuning_lattice (MSJD ladder), frozen. Lattice rotation under fixed bodies is off (n_latrot = 0): its MSJD is 1e5 x smaller than co-tilt's because the steric cages lock lattice and bodies; co-tilt + single-cube rotations still reach every (G, Q). Warm-up 500 fixed in advance.
